title: Resources
description: Articles, blog posts, white papers, application notes, and other materials about the DEEPCRAFT™ AI Hub.
long_description: Articles, blog posts, white papers, application notes, and other materials about the DEEPCRAFT™ AI Hub—its tools, Solutions, Accelerators, and model projects—are collected here. Use these resources to learn more about what you can achieve with Edge AI: real-world applications, practical deployment examples, and inspiration for what is possible on Infineon embedded hardware. Go deeper than the catalog listings to see how others have built with DEEPCRAFT™ Studio, deployed Ready Models, evaluated Model Zoo projects, and applied edge AI across consumer, industrial, and automotive use cases.

boxes.heading: What you'll find here
boxes.text: Content is grouped by type so you can quickly find the format that suits you:

steps.text: Practical walkthroughs and announcements about Edge AI on Infineon hardware.
In-depth technical perspectives on Edge AI technologies and trends.
Solution-focused guides for specific sensors, kits, and use cases.
Step-by-step and conceptual content to help you learn and build.

boxes.heading: More to come
boxes.text: Content will be added below as it becomes available. Browse the resource cards beneath this overview to explore the latest materials.
